nfl_afd_general.q: After a penalty for a foul by Team B prior to, during, or after a play from scrimmage, the ensuing down is first-and-10 for Team A.

nfl_afd_exceptions.q: For the above exceptions, the number of the down and the line to gain remain the same unless a distance penalty places the ball on or in advance of the line to gain

nfl_runoff.q: A team is not permitted to conserve time after the two-minute warning of either half by committing any of these acts: (a) a foul by either team that stops the clock during any dead ball period; (b) intentional grounding; (c) an illegal forward pass; (d) throwing a backward pass out of bounds;

nfl_runoff_defense.q: Item 2. Actions by the Defense. If the action is by the defense, the play clock will be reset to 40 seconds

nfl_other_personal.q: Fouls that include a 15-yard penalty but are not listed in this Section or in Section 3 are considered personal fouls for penalty enforcement purposes.

ncaa_runoff.q: before a change of team possession if either team commits a foul that causes the clock to stop immediately and the penalty for that foul is accepted, the referee will subtract 10 seconds from the game clock

ncaa_runoff_list.q: Any foul that prevents the snap (e.g., false start, encroachment, defensive offside by contact in the neutral zone, etc.) (A.R. 3-4-4-III); 2. Intentional grounding to stop the clock; 3. Incomplete illegal forward pass; 4. Backward pass thrown out of bounds to stop the clock;

ncaa_runoff_not.q: The 10-second rule does not apply if the game clock is not running when the foul occurs or if the foul does not cause the game clock to stop immediately (e.g., illegal formation).

ncaa_personal.q: All fouls in this section (unless noted) and any other acts of unnecessary roughness are personal fouls.

ncaa_personal_penalty.q: Except as otherwise noted, the penalties for all personal fouls are as follows: PENALTY—Personal foul. 15 yards. For dead-ball fouls, 15 yards from the succeeding spot. Automatic first down for fouls by Team B if not in conflict with other rules.

ncaa_flagrant.q: all flagrant fouls (Rule 2-10-3) require ejection or disqualification.

ncaa_targeting_penalty.q: PENALTY—[ARTICLE 3 and ARTICLE 4]—15 yards. For dead-ball fouls, 15 yards from the succeeding spot. Automatic first down for fouls by Team B if not in conflict with other rules.

ncaa_targeting_dq.q: for a player’s first targeting foul in a season, disqualification for the remainder of the game with no carryover disqualification

ncaa_unsportsmanlike_afd.q: Automatic first down for live-ball and dead-ball fouls by Team B if not in conflict with other rules. Flagrant offenders, if players or substitutes, shall be ejected [S47].

entries.name: More than 11 players on the field at the snap

pro.q: Penalty: For more than 11 players on the field of play or the end zone while the ball is in play: Loss of five yards from the previous spot.

college.q: The infraction is treated as a live-ball foul (A.R. 3-5-3-I-VII). PENALTY—Live-ball foul. Five yards at the previous spot. [S22]

pro.note: Spot foul: the yards field is 0 and the cap (none at pro) is foul.dpi.max_yards.

entries.name: Backward pass thrown out of bounds to save time

college.q: All fouls in this section (unless noted) and any other acts of unnecessary roughness are personal fouls.
